name: Venomancer: Venom Fanatic makes Serpent's Fang strike two additional enemies (#1141)
contract: #1141: Venom Fanatic 681059 effect 0 is aura 107 (ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) misc 17 SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS, BasePoints 2 DieSides 1 (+3), EffectSpellClassMask (0,0x1000000,0) = the Serpent's Fang family (ranks 800946, 503931..503935, 552781, 552783). Serpent's Fang effect 0 is SCHOOL_DAMAGE on TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY with EffectChainTarget 0 and EffectDamageMultiplier 1.0. Spell::SelectImplicitTargetObjectTargets calls Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets for that target type, which applies SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS to the chain count (0 -> 3) and searches maxTargets - 1 = 2 extra enemies within the 10 yard magic-class jump radius, so the tooltip 'strikes 2 additional nearby enemies' is the primary target plus two. The chain damage multiplier is 1.0, and the AoE damage reduction in Spell::DoAllEffectOnLaunchTarget excludes SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_MAGIC, so each of the three enemies takes a positive hit. The module's healing hook (venomancer_serpent_fang) is guarded by a script value and fires once per cast. The control casts the same spell at the same cluster in the same run: one damage event without the talent, three with it. All fixtures spawn at the same point, so the fanatic's chain finds enemies within the jump radius. Both players carry spell_hit_rating 10000 so no cast can miss. No script or SQL is needed; this is a regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Serpent's Fang gets no extra jump targets without Venom Fanatic
Venom Fanatic adds 3 to Serpent's Fang's chain target count (rank 800946)
Venom Fanatic adds 3 chain targets to Serpent's Fang rank 503931
Venom Fanatic adds 3 chain targets to Serpent's Fang rank 552783
Venom Fanatic does not reach Venom Bolt
The control still has no extra jump targets
Control casts Serpent's Fang at one of the clustered enemies
Without the talent one enemy is damaged
Let any extra chain hit land
Without the talent still exactly one enemy was damaged
Fanatic casts Serpent's Fang at one of the same cluster
With Venom Fanatic the primary target and two more enemies are damaged
Let any further chain hit land
With Venom Fanatic exactly three enemies were damaged, never a fourth
